Yes, please go ahead and start building it. That summary matches what we worked through together, and it captures everything that matters to me: saving quickly and opening my links, finding things with the richer searches, my own labels, Read later, the preserved pages and PDFs, no duplicates, editing, deleting, the reversible put-away, ordering, doing things to batches, bringing my bookmarks in and getting a copy back out, saved searches, my comfort settings, and all those calm, honest ways of handling when something's missing or goes wrong.

And yes — personal notes, and being able to search within them, are parked for a later round, as we agreed.

So you have my go-ahead to implement this approved scope. I'll be glad to see it come together as the real, working app.
